rationale.intuition: Pomona publishes COMBINED ED admit rate (~16% per CDS) but does not separately report ED1 vs ED2 numbers, even though it offers both rounds. Industry inference: ED1 ~17-19%, ED2 ~10-15% (slightly weaker than ED1 because admit count tapers). Strong unhooked domestic humanities profile with national writing recognition fits Pomona's holistic culture; counselor consensus 13-30%. Engine will likely use school.acceptanceRate (~7%) because ed2AcceptanceRate is null for Pomona — this fixture exists to verify the engine does NOT crash on null ed2AcceptanceRate AND documents the data gap.

sources.name: Pomona CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Pomona reports combined ED admit rate ~16% in CDS C21; does not publish separable ED I vs ED II numbers despite offering both.

sources.name: College Kickstart Pomona ED2 Analysis 2024
sources.evidence: Pomona offers ED2 but combines reporting; College Kickstart estimates ED2 admit rate ~10-15% based on yield modeling.

sources.name: Crimson T10 LAC Strategy Guide 2024
sources.evidence: Strong unhooked humanities applicants with national-level recognition at T10 LACs cluster 15-30% in ED rounds (combined or separable).

sources.name: NACAC State of College Admission 2024
sources.evidence: LAC ED yield runs 50-60%; ED2 admit rates trail ED1 by 3-5pp at most T10 LACs that report separately.

wontFix.reason: Pomona publishes combined ED rate (not separable ED1/ED2), so `school.ed2AcceptanceRate` is null in our seed. PredictionHookModifiersService.getBaseRate() will fall through the ED2 branch (line 166-167 requires ed2AcceptanceRate != null) and use school.acceptanceRate (~7%) as base, producing a prediction materially below the industry ED2 band. The expected range here reflects what counselors would say for a strong ED2 applicant — engine will under-predict until either (a) Pomona publishes separable ED2 rates, or (b) we add a fallback that uses edAcceptanceRate × 0.7 when ed2AcceptanceRate is null but hasEarlyDecision2 is true.
wontFix.followUp: Add ed2-fallback heuristic in PredictionHookModifiersService.getBaseRate() — when round=ED2 and ed2AcceptanceRate is null but hasEarlyDecision2 is true, use edAcceptanceRate * 0.7 as a defensible proxy (per College Kickstart aggregation).
